'''Sentry towers''', also known as '''recon-towers''' or '''sentry posts''', were small vertical structures used as a vantage point for security and military forces. They were utilized by various groups, including the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].

[[File:Sentry_post.png|thumb|right|200px|A Wookiee sentry post]]
The Rebel Alliance used recon-towers which rose high above the [[Tree/Legends|treetops]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. From them, [[Rebel sentry/Legends|Rebel sentries]] would track incoming and outgoing traffic.<ref name="A New Hope" />
